text:
{
  "protocol_id": "CTJ301UC201",
  "version": "Ver.1.1",
  "previous_version": "Ver.1.0",
  "spoken_summary": "Protocol version 1.1 updates study countries, randomisation stratification, eligibility criteria, PK and safety visit schedules, and adds new FDA-recommended secondary endpoints and adverse events of special interest. These changes affect clinical sites, investigators, patients, and the data management team who must update the EDC build with new PK visits, forms, codelists, and edit checks.",
  "changes": [
    {
      "id": "CH-1",
      "section": "Cover Page",
      "page": 1,
      "quote": "Multicenter, international, across Mainland China, Taiwan, Republic of Korea and Australia",
      "type": "admin",
      "summary": "Replaced Germany with Australia as a participating country/region.",
      "affects_edc": false,
      "edc_note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-2",
      "section": "Version of Protocol or Protocol Amendment",
      "page": 5,
      "quote": "VERSION OF PROTOCOL OR PROTOCOL AMENDMENT",
      "type": "admin",
      "summary": "Added a Version of Protocol or Protocol Amendment history table.",
      "affects_edc": false,
      "edc_note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-3",
      "section": "Synopsis / 2.2 Endpoints",
      "page": 7,
      "quote": "Change from Baseline to Week 12 in modified Mayo score (=full Mayo score excluding Physician’s Global Assessment (PGA) subscore). Change from Baseline to Weeks 4, 6, 8, 10, and 12 in PGA score. FDA-defined remission at Week 12, defined as Stool frequency subscore=0, Rectal bleeding subscore=0, and Endoscopy subscore =0 or 1.",
      "type": "endpoint",
      "summary": "Added three FDA-recommended secondary endpoints: modified Mayo score change at Week 12, PGA score change at Weeks 4-12, and FDA-defined remission at Week 12.",
      "affects_edc": false,
      "edc_note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-4",
      "section": "3.1.2 Overall Design",
      "page": 26,
      "quote": "Randomisation will be stratified by prior corticosteroids treatment (yes/no) and consent to participate in PK substudy (yes/no).",
      "type": "procedure",
      "summary": "Modified randomisation stratification factors from elevated CRP and stable conventional treatment to prior corticosteroids treatment and PK substudy consent.",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Update the Randomisation (RAND) form stratification fields to capture prior corticosteroids treatment and PK substudy consent."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-5",
      "section": "3.1.2 Overall Design",
      "page": 27,
      "quote": "At 1st dose: pre-dose and 0.5, 1, 2 (end of infusion), 6, 48, 144 (Day 6), and 240 (Day 10) h after the start of the 1st administration;",
      "type": "schedule",
      "summary": "Changed the PK blood sampling timepoint from 1.5 hours to 2 hours (end of infusion).",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Update the PKTPT codelist on the PK form to replace the 1.5 h timepoint with 2 h (EOI)."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-6",
      "section": "3.3 Safety Review Committee",
      "page": 29,
      "quote": "The SRC is an expert advisory group commissioned and charged with the responsibility of evaluating, primarily, cumulative safety data at regular intervals.",
      "type": "admin",
      "summary": "Renamed the Data and Safety Monitoring Committee (DSMC) to Safety Review Committee (SRC) and updated its description.",
      "affects_edc": false,
      "edc_note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-7",
      "section": "4.1.1 Inclusion Criteria",
      "page": 34,
      "quote": "4. During Day -35 to Day-6 prior to Randomisation, an endoscopy subscore ≥2.",
      "type": "eligibility",
      "summary": "Shortened the screening endoscopy window from Day -60 to Day -6 to Day -35 to Day -6 prior to randomisation.",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Update edit checks on the ENDO and IE forms to validate that the screening endoscopy occurs within Day -35 to Day -6 prior to randomisation."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-8",
      "section": "4.1.1 Inclusion Criteria",
      "page": 34,
      "quote": "5. Treated with conventional non-biological UC therapy: with corticosteroids stable for at least 2 weeks prior to Randomization at no more than 20 mg prednisone (or equivalent), and/or with medications containing 5-aminosalicylates (5-ASA) at no less than 2 g 5-ASA per day for at least 3 months and stable for at least 4 weeks prior to Randomization, and/or with azathioprine (AZA) at no less than 1.5 mg/kg/day or mercaptopurine (6-MP) at no less than 0.75 mg/kg/day for at least 6 months and stable for at least 6 weeks prior to Randomization.",
      "type": "eligibility",
      "summary": "Lowered the minimum required 5-ASA dose from 3 g per day to 2 g per day to meet Taiwan guidelines.",
      "affects_edc": false,
      "edc_note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-9",
      "section": "4.1.1 Inclusion Criteria",
      "page": 34,
      "quote": "8. The subject should be able to read and write to understand and fill out Patient Diary.",
      "type": "eligibility",
      "summary": "Added Inclusion Criterion 8 requiring subjects to be able to read and write to complete the Patient Diary.",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Add Inclusion Criterion 8 to the Inclusion/Exclusion Criteria (IE) form."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-10",
      "section": "4.1.2 Exclusion Criteria",
      "page": 35,
      "quote": "17. Presence or history of active tuberculosis (TB) or latent TB infection, defined as 1) a positive QuantiFERON-TB Gold test at Screening, or 2) a positive T-spot test within 4 weeks of Randomisation and evidence of current or previous pulmonary tuberculosis by chest X-ray within 12 weeks of Randomisation.",
      "type": "eligibility",
      "summary": "Expanded Exclusion Criterion 17 to exclude patients with latent TB infection and defined the diagnostic criteria.",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Update Exclusion Criterion 17 on the IE form and ensure the TB form captures QuantiFERON-TB Gold or T-spot and chest X-ray results."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-11",
      "section": "5.1 Treatments Administered",
      "page": 39,
      "quote": "Manufacturer: Octoplus Development B.V. (now as Dr. Reddy’s Research &Development B.V.) , Netherlands",
      "type": "admin",
      "summary": "Corrected the IMP manufacturer name from OctoPlus N.V. to Octoplus Development B.V.",
      "affects_edc": false,
      "edc_note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-12",
      "section": "5.1 Treatments Administered",
      "page": 39,
      "quote": "The infusion time is 2 hours.",
      "type": "procedure",
      "summary": "Removed the ±3 minute tolerance from the 2-hour IMP infusion time.",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Remove or relax any edit check on the IMP Administration (EX) form that enforces a ±3 minute window around the 2-hour infusion time."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-13",
      "section": "6.2.3 Baseline Visit (Visit 2)",
      "page": 50,
      "quote": "Diary dispensing",
      "type": "schedule",
      "summary": "Added diary dispensing and diary review to Baseline Visit (Visit 2), which were omitted in Version 1.0.",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Add diary dispensing and diary review collection to Visit 2 (Baseline)."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-14",
      "section": "6.2.4 12-week Treatment Period (Visits 3 to 8)",
      "page": 50,
      "quote": "Blood sampling for anti-TJ301 antibodies (Visits 3, 4, 6, and 8)",
      "type": "schedule",
      "summary": "Added blood sampling for anti-TJ301 antibodies at Visit 3 (Day 14).",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Schedule anti-TJ301 antibody blood sampling collection at Visit 3."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-15",
      "section": "6.2.4 12-week Treatment Period (Visits 3 to 8)",
      "page": 50,
      "quote": "Physical examination (Visits 4, 6, and 8; body weight only)",
      "type": "schedule",
      "summary": "Removed physical examination from Visits 3, 5, and 7.",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Remove the Physical Examination form from Visits 3, 5, and 7."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-16",
      "section": "6.2.5 PK Visits",
      "page": 51,
      "quote": "At Visits 2.1, 2.2, 2.3, 7.1, 7.2, 7,3, and 8.1, no other data will be collected.",
      "type": "schedule",
      "summary": "The protocol schedule includes dedicated PK visits (V2.1, V2.2, V2.3, V7.1, V7.2, V7.3, and V8.1) that are not present in the current EDC build.",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Add visits V2.1 (Day 2), V2.2 (Day 6, ±1 day), V2.3 (Day 10, ±1 day), V7.1 (Day 72), V7.2 (Day 76), V7.3 (Day 80, ±1 day), and V8.1 (Day 90, ±2 days) with the PK form and missing PKTPT codelist values (48 h, 144 h, 240 h, 480 h)."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-17",
      "section": "6.3 Safety Follow-up Visit (Visit 9)",
      "page": 52,
      "quote": "TB test",
      "type": "schedule",
      "summary": "Added a TB test at the Safety Follow-up Visit (Visit 9).",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Schedule the TB Test (TB) form at Visit 9 (Safety Follow-up Visit)."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-18",
      "section": "7.1.1 Clinical and Endoscopic Disease Activity (Mayo Score)",
      "page": 53,
      "quote": "Note that the criteria of endoscopic appearance assessment in this study are DIFFERENT from the original criteria in (13). The Endoscopy subscore is modified so that a value of 1 does not include friability. Personnel responsible for endoscopic evaluation should NOT refer to the original criteria.",
      "type": "procedure",
      "summary": "Added an explicit warning that the modified Mayo endoscopic appearance criteria exclude friability from a score of 1.",
      "affects_edc": false,
      "edc_note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-19",
      "section": "8.3 Adverse Events of Special Interest",
      "page": 61,
      "quote": "Adverse events of special interest include adverse events observed in earlier clinical development of TJ301 and those resulting from blocking IL-6 signaling shown by other drugs or investigational products.",
      "type": "safety",
      "summary": "Added a new section defining Adverse Events of Special Interest (AESI) for TJ301 and IL-6 inhibitors.",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Add an Adverse Event of Special Interest (AESI) indicator field to the Adverse Events (AE) form."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-20",
      "section": "8.5.2 Collection, Recording and Reporting of Serious Adverse Events",
      "page": 64,
      "quote": "Zhijia Han",
      "type": "admin",
      "summary": "Updated the CRO contact person for SAE reporting from Haiyan Liu to Zhijia Han.",
      "affects_edc": false,
      "edc_note": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-21",
      "section": "Appendix 2 – Laboratory Parameters",
      "page": 87,
      "quote": "TB (QuantiFERON-TB Gold; or T-spot test plus chest X-ray)",
      "type": "procedure",
      "summary": "Added specific assay details for HIV, HBV, HCV, TB, EBV, and CMV screening tests.",
      "affects_edc": true,
      "edc_note": "Update the VIRO and TB forms to capture the specified assay methods for HIV, HBV, HCV, TB, EBV, and CMV."
    },
    {
      "id": "CH-22",
      "section": "Appendix 3 – Patient Diary (blank sample)",
      "page": 89,
      "quote": "Instructions for recording the number of stools and their worst rectal bleeding over a 24-hour period:",
      "type": "procedure",
      "summary": "Added instructions for patients on how to fill out the Patient Diary for stool frequency and rectal bleeding.",
      "affects_edc": false,
      "edc_note": ""
    }
  ]
}
